title: Truncated Gpr114-based ultrasound-hypersensitive gene circuit for controlled expression of therapeutics.
authors: Wu, Pengying; Lai, Yubo; Liu, Yang; Li, Zihang; Liu, Zhaoyou; Wang, Lantian; An, Jieyuan; Liu, Yunnan; Wei, Shuzhe; Sun, Yue; Yang, Guodong; Yuan, Lijun
one_liner_zh: 该文利用AlphaFold3和MD模拟设计超声敏感受体，并构建基因回路调控转录因子ID3表达用于肿瘤治疗，虽涉及蛋白结构预测和转录因子表达，但核心是细胞治疗应用而非TF-DNA互作机制研究。
abstract: Sonogenetic holds great potential for modulating cellular functions and behaviors. However, developing hypersensitive ultrasound (US)-responsive receptors remains a substantial challenge. Here, we combine AlphaFold3 prediction with molecular dynamics simulations to identify a hypersensitive Gpr114 protein variant (T-Gpr114) that responds to short-pulse US stimulation for activation. We further design sonogenetic macrophages (MPhi) by fusing T-Gpr114 to a synthetic genetic circuit, this circuit initiates expression of the transcription factor ID3 upon short-pulse US treatment. In vivo assays using female tumor-bearing mice demonstrate that sonogenetic-MPhi suppress tumor growth with no obvious systemic toxicity, and exhibit enhanced anti-tumor efficacy relative to cells with constitutive ID3 expression. Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals that sonogentic-MPhi potentiate the recruitment recruitment of CD8(+) T cells compared with constitutive ID3-overexpressing macrophages. In this work, this T-Gpr114-based US-hypersensitive gene circuit extends the scope of remote control over the activation of diverse cell types, thereby facilitating the programming of therapeutic cells.
abstract_zh: 声遗传学在调控细胞功能和行为方面具有巨大潜力。然而，开发超灵敏的超声（US）响应受体仍是一项重大挑战。在此，我们将AlphaFold3预测与分子动力学模拟相结合，鉴定出一种对短脉冲US刺激激活响应的超灵敏Gpr114蛋白变体（T-Gpr114）。我们进一步通过将T-Gpr114与合成基因回路融合，设计了声遗传学巨噬细胞（MPhi），该回路在短脉冲US处理后启动转录因子ID3的表达。使用雌性荷瘤小鼠的体内实验表明，声遗传学-MPhi抑制肿瘤生长且无明显全身毒性，并与组成性表达ID3的细胞相比，表现出增强的抗肿瘤疗效。单细胞RNA测序揭示，与组成性过表达ID3的巨噬细胞相比，声遗传学-MPhi增强了CD8(+) T细胞的募集。在本工作中，这种基于T-Gpr114的US超灵敏基因回路扩展了对多种细胞类型激活的远程控制范围，从而促进治疗性细胞的编程。
